Hi Patrick — adding the technical export plan below. I attached a draft playbook (export-playbook-draft.md) that maps fields and shows a manifest example.

Summary of what we log (operator/admin activity):
- Authentication events: console login success/failure, SSO assertions, MFA challenges (no raw tokens)
- Authorization events: role grants/revokes, group membership changes, permission policy updates
- Credential lifecycle: API key creation/rotation/revocation, service principal ops
- Privileged operations: model deployments, model parameter changes, KV cache clears, manual prompt-store exports, dataset re-imports
- Console & API actions: route changes, config flags toggled, rollout/canary promotions, aborts
- Audit meta: acting_user_id (pseudonymizable), request_id, origin IP, user_agent, timestamp, request_payload_ref (pointer to immutable blob when needed)

Retention and export options:
- Default retention: 365 days for admin_activity by default for managed Hosted plans; Dedicated/Private can be configured per contract
- Per-tenant retention: available for Dedicated & Private, with minimums enforced for compliance requests
- Export formats:
  1) Point-in-time tar.gz snapshot (compressed NDJSON files per event type) + signed-manifest.txt (SHA256 + HMAC-SHA256) — good for attested handoffs and for auditors requiring an immutable bundle
  2) Daily incremental S3 feed (gzip'ed NDJSON) with a signed manifest per day — good for automated ingest by security teams
  3) Real-time streaming via secure Kafka or S3 PutEvents for customers on Dedicated/private deployments that need low-latency ingestion

PII redaction & field-level controls:
- Fields are mapped in the playbook; we support three redaction modes: none, hash-only (SHA256), full-redact (replace with <REDACTED>). Hash-only retains consistent pseudonyms for correlation without exposing raw identifiers.
- Recommended for SIG/CAIQ: provide hash-only for user identifiers and redact free-form fields (prompt text) unless customer explicitly authorizes inclusion.

Sampling & attestations:
- We can produce a 7-day sample bundle within 3 business days for Hosted customers (subject to workload), 1-2 business days for Dedicated with entitlement. Sample includes NDJSON + manifest + a short readme describing file naming and schema.
- Manifest contains: file list, sha256 checksums, HMAC using customer-provided key, signed manifest timestamp and attesting service principal id. Example included in the playbook.

Operational notes / caveats:
- For event payloads that reference user-submitted content (prompts), we treat this as high-sensitivity PII and recommend redaction unless required by auditor.
- For very large request volumes we may sample non-privileged events; privileged actions (role grants, revokes, key ops) are never sampled and are always included in full exports.

Attached: export-playbook-draft.md (field map + manifest example).
